# KnowYi Technologies Inc.

Canonical name: KnowYi Technologies Inc.
Short name: KnowYi
Website: https://www.knowyi.tech/
Headquarters: Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
Founder & CEO: Zhizhu (Ella) Meng
GitHub organization: https://github.com/KnowYiTech
Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140697716

KnowYi is an industrial technology company focused on the transition from hardware engineering to physical production. It is building a manufacturing intelligence layer connecting engineering intent, manufacturing decisions and physical production outcomes.

Canonical thesis:
Engineering intent -> manufacturing decision -> physical outcome -> better next decision.
